title: The acceptance criteria format, version 1
description: The acceptance criteria of a work item: a summary of what the work item must achieve, and the criteria that say when it is achieved, each with the check that shows it. A criterion that is dropped stays in the list, with removed and its reason. The file of a version of a structured artifact type. Each criterion's id is unique in the document, which a JSON Schema cannot check. The file's size limit is the artifact type's, which a JSON Schema cannot check either. No object has a member this schema does not define.

summary.description: What the work item must achieve, in plain text.

criteria.description: Every criterion, in the order they were written, at least one. A removed criterion stays in the list.

criterion.description: One criterion: a condition that the finished work item meets, and how to check that it does. removed is present exactly when the criterion is dropped.

id.description: The criterion's id, unique in the document: ac- and a number from 1 to 9999 with no leading zero, such as ac-3.

text.description: The condition that the finished work item meets, in plain text.

check.description: How to check that the condition is met, as free text: what to look at, run or ask, and what result counts as met.

removed.description: Present when the criterion is dropped from the work item: the reason. The criterion keeps its id and its text.
The mark of a dropped criterion.

reason.description: Why the criterion is dropped, in plain text.

criterion_id.description: A criterion's id: ac- and a number from 1 to 9999 with no leading zero, such as ac-3.

text.description: Text that may span lines. Tab, line feed and carriage return are its only control characters: it has none of U+0000 to U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F. It has none of the bidirectional controls, the marks U+061C, U+200E and U+200F, the embeddings and overrides U+202A to U+202E and the isolates U+2066 to U+2069; the separators U+2028 and U+2029; and the format characters U+00AD, U+180E, U+200B, U+2060 to U+2064, U+FEFF and U+FFF9 to U+FFFB.

line.description: Text on one line: text as $defs text defines it, with no control character at all, so no tab, line feed or carriage return.
